title: Genuinely well-done: signer_discovery AKI-present-but-no-SKI-match returns None, not DN fallback
description: In pkix-revocation/src/signer_discovery.rs lines 100-106, when the CRL has an AKI keyIdentifier but no bundle cert's SKI matches, discover_crl_signer returns None immediately without falling back to DN matching. This is a deliberate and correct security choice: the AKI is the definitive signal in key-rollover/bridge-CA topologies where multiple certs share a DN. Falling through to DN match when AKI is present but unmatched would silently select a wrong-key cert — exactly the attack AKI is designed to prevent. The comment at line 100-106 documents this reasoning. Worth defending if someone suggests 'try DN too' as a lenient fallback.
